description: Lausanne's underground cadastre records water, sewerage, electricity, district heating, gas, telecommunications and other utility conduits. Surveyed infrastructure is supplemented with information from network owners and older plans. Coverage includes public land and part of private land in Lausanne. The provider offers free professional-use extracts in DWG or combined PDF and DXF, limited to the project area and a maximum of 200,000 square metres per order. The recommended scale is 1:200 in CH1903+. Provider terms restrict use to the user's mandate and prohibit redistribution and commercial reuse. The inventory is incomplete; network owners' plans remain the authoritative documents. Elevation conventions differ by network, and the district-heating reference changed around 2024. These caveats matter for network-flow simulation and analysis of dependencies between co-located utilities. No hydraulic or electrical parameters beyond the metadata are assumed. Related records describe combined network plans for Pully and Belmont-sur-Lausanne. Viageo's public demo label leaves production access unresolved; no extract was ordered or downloaded.
